This continues the decision register of the stream. Business rules are in
`modernization/rules/interest/decisions.md` (ids INT-Q.., INT-H..) and are not repeated or changed here. The rows below
are the release and coexistence choices the design had to assume. None is answered; the design uses the option marked
*proposed* until the owner decides. They are deliberately not tickets.

| Id | Question | Options | Design assumes | Owner | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| REL-01 | How does the new job share data with the jobs that stay on the mainframe? | **A** file bridge at the dataset boundary: unload, load, run, export, write back (proposed)<br>**B** replicate the VSAM files continuously into PostgreSQL<br>**C** move every reader and writer of the four files first | A | enterprise architect | OPEN |
| REL-02 | Which copy of the account data is the system of record while POSTTRAN and the CICS programs stay? | **A** the mainframe file ACCTDATA; the PostgreSQL table is a copy refreshed for each run (proposed)<br>**B** the PostgreSQL table | A | data owner | OPEN |
| REL-03 | What is written back to ACCTDATA after a run? | **A** the whole record of every account the run updated, while the CICS files are closed (proposed)<br>**B** the whole file | A | mainframe application owner | OPEN |
| REL-04 | How many cycles run side by side before cutover? | **A** two consecutive cycles with no unexplained difference (proposed)<br>**B** another number | A | business owner | OPEN |
| REL-05 | What is the bar for 'equal' in the side-by-side run? | **A** every field of every record of SYSTRAN and ACCTDATA equal, timestamps compared under the rule of SS3 (proposed)<br>**B** totals only | A | business owner | OPEN |
| REL-06 | In which cycle does the new job take over? | **A** the first cycle after REL-04 is met and every gate is green (proposed)<br>**B** a fixed date | A | release manager | OPEN |
| REL-07 | Until which point can a cutover run be abandoned without a business correction? | **A** until COMBTRAN starts; after that only a forward fix (proposed)<br>**B** another point | A | mainframe operations owner | OPEN |
| REL-08 | Which code page and sign convention do the unloaded files use? | **A** as the parity tool assumes: cp037, C/D signs (proposed, unconfirmed)<br>**B** other, stated by the data owner | A | mainframe data owner | OPEN |
| REL-09 | Who starts the new job? | **A** the existing Control-M folder; the INTCALC job definition is replaced and keeps its condition names (proposed)<br>**B** a new scheduler | A | scheduler owner | OPEN |
| REL-10 | What does a failed run report to the scheduler? | **A** a non-zero exit code mapped to NOTOK, with the legacy message text in the log (proposed)<br>**B** a specific code agreed with operations in place of user abend 999 | A | mainframe operations owner | OPEN |
| REL-11 | How is a run that failed part-way continued? | **A** restart of the same run from the last committed account (proposed; the legacy procedure is INT-H02)<br>**B** restore and rerun from the start, as on the mainframe | A | mainframe operations owner | OPEN |
| REL-12 | How long are a run's rows kept in interest_transaction and interest_run? | **A** five runs, as GDG LIMIT(5) keeps five generations (proposed)<br>**B** another retention | A | data owner | OPEN |
| REL-13 | How long does the legacy INTCALC job stay available as a fallback after cutover? | **A** two cycles after the cutover cycle (proposed)<br>**B** another period | A | mainframe application owner | OPEN |
